name: Forced displacement
summary: IOM says 300,000+ fled fighting in western Yemen over two months; no UN-confirmed new event over 500,000 a month
state: IOM said on 1 Nov that more than 300,000 people had fled fighting in western Yemen, almost all in the previous two months, below the 500,000-a-month line (Khaleej Times). IOM counted about 8.59 million internally displaced in Sudan in October, up by about 8,900 from September (Dabanga via AllAfrica, 17 Nov). Searches on 21 Nov found no UN-confirmed new event reaching 500,000 in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Displaced people in western Yemen and Sudan need shelter, food and water, per IOM. Large new movements tend to bring UN flash appeals and pressure on neighbouring states.
rubric_hit: Normal: no new event over 500,000 a month; Yemen 300,000+ over two months (IOM, 1 Nov)

sources.title: Khaleej Times — More than 300,000 have fled fighting in western Yemen: UN
AllAfrica (Dabanga) — Number of displaced people rose in seven Sudan states in October: IOM

why: Over 120 million people are forcibly displaced; new mass displacement drives regional instability and migration politics.
